public_body: Minuteman Regional Vocational Technical School Committee
overall: The Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law. Its January 10, 2023 minutes recorded the required announcement of the January 7 executive session minute review; the other claims were declined as untimely, unspecific, or unapproved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the committee never announced results of its reviews of withheld executive session minutes at the next meeting, as the law requires.
allegations.key_passage: Complainants must allege violations with a degree of specificity, as our office will not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the June 18, 2013 review of executive session minutes and the 2021 release of 2012-2013 minutes lacked a recorded announcement; the claims were filed too late.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, at the latest, allegations concerning the procedures the Committee used in reviewing and releasing the 2012 and 2013 executive session minutes were discoverable as of March 23, 2021, when the complainant was made aware that the executive session minutes had been previously approved for public release.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges no announcement was recorded after the December 13 and 20, 2022 executive sessions.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, there was no expectation that the minutes of the next meetings thereafter would capture an announcement regarding minutes reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the January 10, 2023 meeting minutes failed to capture an announcement of the January 7, 2023 executive session minute review.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, it is clear that the Committee complied with the Open Meeting Law’s requirement that “[s]uch determination shall be announced at the body’s next meeting and such announcement shall be included in the minutes of that meeting.”

allegations.summary: Complaint covers the January 7, 2023 meeting minutes, which had not been approved when the complaint was filed.
allegations.key_passage: We do not review allegations concerning the minutes of the Committee’s January 7 meeting, as those minutes were not approved until April 11, 2023, after this complaint was filed.
